svg.aria-label: Fig 2's instance and query, with external engines on a shelf on the far side of the object store: Databricks, Trino, Athena, BigQuery and DuckDB. Everything TO REMOTE uploaded is in cold storage as standard Parquet, one file per partition on Hive-style paths, so these engines can run the same query over those files in place, all at once. Pick the reader: QuestDB lights what it reads on its own bench and in cold storage, as in Fig 2; the external engines light only partitions in cold storage, on the deck, and their range reads run back off the deck to every terminal in parallel. A band along the deck front marks the sealed partitions, which never change, the uploaded ones not yet sealed, which a late write can replace, and the newest stretch, not uploaded yet, which only QuestDB can see.
svg.text: a late write replaces the object
the active partition and the last hour
